checksumDiscovery.noChecksumsHint: Try Exhaustive sensitivity, or enable custom polynomial search.
checksumDiscovery.noResultsDescription: Select frames and click "Run Analysis" to detect checksum patterns.
checksumDiscovery.noneFoundCount_one: {{count}} frame ID with no checksum found
checksumDiscovery.noneFoundCount_other: {{count}} frame IDs with no checksum found
checksumDiscovery.panelDescription: Works out what explains each frame ID's checksum byte: the built-in algorithms, sums with a constant offset, or a recovered CRC polynomial.

rejected.notAFunctionOfTheOtherBytes: changes on its own — a counter, not a checksum
rejected.tooOftenUnchanged: sits still while the payload moves — a sensor reading
rejected.tooFewDistinctValues: too few values for the payloads it saw

checksumDiscovery.searchCustomPolynomialsHint: Recovers a CRC that is not one of the standards. Adds a few milliseconds per frame ID.

sensitivityHint.strict: Only bytes that look strongly like a checksum are solved.
sensitivityHint.balanced: The usual choice — bytes that plausibly carry a checksum are solved.
sensitivityHint.exhaustive: Solves every byte that was not ruled out outright. Slower, and reports more near misses.

modbusUnitId.fc43DescriptionSuffix: first to retrieve vendor, product, and revision info. If the device doesn't support FC43, a register read is used as a fallback.
modbusUnitId.scanDescription: Scans {{device}} for active unit IDs {{start}}–{{end}}. Devices supporting FC43 will show vendor, product, and revision details. Others are detected via {{type}} register {{register}}.

modbusConnection.needHost: Enter a host address to scan.

modbusRegister.scanDescription: Scans {{device}} for {{type}} registers {{start}}–{{end}} on unit {{unit}}. Discovered registers will appear in the frame picker.
modbusRegister.passesHint: Each register is read once per pass. Run the Payload Changes tool afterwards to see which ones moved — those are live telemetry rather than static configuration.
modbusRegister.advancedHint: Raise the timeout for a slow gateway. Turn on per-request reconnect for cheap devices that only serve one Modbus conversation per connection; a short settle delay usually goes with it.
modbusRegister.tooManyRegisters: {{count}} registers is over the {{max}} limit — narrow the range.

checksumNote.columnNearlyConstant: Checksum column takes only {{distinct}} distinct values — may be padding
checksumNote.columnVaries: Checksum column takes {{distinct}} distinct values across {{samples}} frames
checksumNote.constantPadding: Byte {{position}} is {{value}} in every frame — treated as padding, not checksum
checksumNote.constantPaddingRun: Bytes {{from}} to {{to}} are {{value}} in every frame — treated as padding, not checksum
checksumNote.highByteConstant: High byte of the checksum never changes — may be a 1-byte checksum
checksumNote.noneButLastByteVaries: No known algorithm reproduced the checksum. The last byte does vary ({{distinct}} distinct values across {{frames}} frames), which is consistent with a checksum, so the algorithm may be one not built in — try Checksum Discovery to brute-force CRC polynomials, or configure it manually below.
checksumNote.noneLastByteConstant: No checksum found. The last byte is {{value}} in all {{frames}} frames, so it is unlikely to be a checksum at all — try another position, or check the framing.
checksumNote.startsAfterHeader: Calculation starts after a declared header field (byte {{byte}})

modbusPoll.pauseTitle: Stop polling {{device}} and hand it to the scanning tools

modbusFc.description: Reads one address on each of the four read function codes, for {{count}} unit(s) — {{requests}} requests in total.
modbusFc.hintFound: An exception means the device serves that function code and the address was simply wrong — worth sweeping. Silent usually means the function code isn't implemented at all.
modbusFc.hintNothing: Nothing answered. Another client may hold the device — most serve one Modbus connection at a time — or the address is wrong, or the timeout too short.
